close_reason: MtaStsError: replaced DnsTxtInvalid(String) with DnsTxtMultipleRecords/DnsTxtMissingId/DnsTxtIdTooLong/DnsTxtIdInvalid/DnsLookupFailed; added PolicyFetchRedirectForbidden/PolicyFetchHttpError/PolicyFetchTooLarge. fetch_url now takes &str. All 291 smtp + 254 mail tests pass.
description: MtaStsError::DnsTxtInvalid(String), PolicyFetchFailed(String), PolicyParseFailed(String), TlsCertInvalid(String) wrap opaque strings. Callers (e.g. in a retry scheduler or TLSRPT reporter) cannot distinguish 'domain not found' from 'multiple records' from 'id too long' without parsing the message string. Structured variants (e.g. DnsTxtMultipleRecords, DnsTxtMissingId, PolicyFetchTimeout vs PolicyFetchHttpError { status }) let callers match on specific conditions without fragile string-contains logic.
title: MtaStsError String variants lose structured fields for programmatic handling
